name: lance_3b_mlx (image variant)
description: MLX safetensors port of ByteDance Lance image-3B weight (Lance_3B/). Verified byte-identical with the original PT-side conversion target.

source_pt.note: Our pinned PT snapshot of Lance_3B is F32; the conversion is F32->F32, byte-equal. (Current upstream HF ships bf16, 12.37 GB; our F32 snapshot predates/diverges from it, consistent with the refs/Lance divergence.)

conversion.dtype: float32 (PT F32 -> MLX F32, float values byte-equal)

verification.byte_identical_with: RockTalk/Lance-3B-MLX (F32, same SHA256 5ede2f0a). NOTE: this is the F32 build; a separate bf16 build (different file) is mlx-community/Lance-3B-bf16.
stages_validated: STAGE 2: Qwen2 backbone forward cos = 1.000000 vs PT
STAGE 4: MoE-gen routing cos = 1.000000 vs clean PT re-impl
STAGE 5: image VAE round-trip >= 40 dB PSNR (T=1)
STAGE 6: T2I 30-step latent cos >= 0.999 vs PT 30-step
STAGE 7: TI2I 3-forward cos >= 0.999 vs PT, real-photo edits match RockTalk reference

notes: This safetensors file covers the LLM backbone + adapters. The ViT and the Wan 2.2 VAE weights are loaded from separate files.
The video variant is Lance_3B_Video/ in this same repo (a standalone F32 weight that bundles the video ViT); see the model card.
F32-preserving conversion: PT and MLX share identical floating-point bit patterns, so cos = 1.000000 at the conversion gate is by construction, not by luck.
